instruction: Design a module that implements a shift register of length 3 using a single D flip-flop and a multiplexer. The module should have three inputs: clk, d, and shift. When shift is low, the module should behave like a regular D flip-flop, storing the value of d on the rising edge of clk. When shift is high, the module should shift the stored value to the next flip-flop on the rising edge of clk. The output of the third flip-flop should be the output of the module.
